en: If people lived forever, the world would become very crowded, as [[many]] now already [[act]] as if they had unlimited time left.
me: If people lived forever, the world would become very crowded, as
as if they had unlimited time left.
easy: as if they had unlimited time left
마치 무한한 시간이 남아 있는 것처럼.
If people lived forever, the world would become very crowded
사람들이 영원히 산다면(live(살다)) 세상은 매우 붐빌 것이다(become(되다)).
요약: 영원히 못 사는데도 이미 많은 사람이 시간이 무한한 듯 행동한다.
notes: as if + 과거형: 사실과 다른 상상. have ✕ → had ○
many는 여기서 '많은 사람들'이라는 뜻의 주어로 쓰였다.

en: [[You]] [[may discover]] [[hidden talents]] if you try new hobbies, especially if you commit to practicing regularly.
me: if you try new hobbies, especially if you commit to practicing regularly.
easy: especially if you commit to practicing regularly
요약: 새 취미를 꾸준히 해 보면 숨은 재능을 찾을 수 있다.
notes: 조건 부사절(if)은 현재가 미래를 대신: if you commit ○ / will commit ✕
commit to + -ing: 이 to는 전치사라 뒤에 -ing (practicing).

en: He speaks as if I had said something wrong at the last meeting, although everyone thought I was right, and [[I]] [[would have clarified]] [[my point]] immediately if he had asked me directly.
key: 나는 내 요점을 분명히 했을 것이다.
me: He speaks as if I had said something wrong at the last meeting, although everyone thought I was right, and
immediately if he had asked me directly.
easy: I would have clarified my point
나는 내 요점을 분명히 했을 것이다(clarify(명확히 하다)).
if he had asked me directly
He speaks as if I had said something wrong at the last meeting
그는 마치 내가 지난 회의에서 틀린 말을 했던 것처럼 말한다(speak(말하다)).
요약: 그가 직접 물었다면 바로 설명했을 텐데, 그는 내가 틀렸다는 듯 말한다.
notes: would have p.p. ↔ if + had p.p. (과거 반대). asked ✕ → had asked ○
as if I had said: 말하는 때보다 앞선 일이라 had p.p.

en: I would have visited you in London if I had known you were staying there at that time, since [[missing that trip]] [[left]] [[me]] [[feeling disappointed]] for weeks afterward.
key: 그 여행을 놓친 것이 나를 실망한 기분으로 남겨 두었다.
me: I would have visited you in London if I had known you were staying there at that time, since
easy: Missing that trip left me feeling disappointed
그 여행을 놓친 것이 나를 실망한 기분으로 남겨 두었다(leave(남기다)).
I would have visited you in London if I had known you were staying there at that time
그때 네가 런던에 머무는 줄(stay(머무르다)) 알았더라면(know(알다)) 널 찾아갔을 텐데(visit(방문하다)).
요약: 그 여행을 놓쳐서 몇 주 동안 실망한 채로 지냈다.
notes: 사람이 느끼는 감정 → -ed (I felt disappointed), 감정을 주는 쪽 → -ing (a disappointing result). feeling disappointing ✕ → feeling disappointed ○
주어 찾기: missing that trip(동명사구) 전체가 주어, 동사는 left.

en: If diamonds grew on trees like apples, we could find them easily and quickly, but if the price of diamonds drops sharply, [[jewelers]] [[will struggle]] to make a profit.
me: If diamonds grew on trees like apples, we could find them easily and quickly, but if the price of diamonds drops sharply,
easy: if the price of diamonds drops sharply
If diamonds grew on trees like apples, we could find them easily and quickly
다이아몬드가 사과처럼 나무에서 자란다면(grow(자라다)) 쉽고 빠르게 찾을 텐데.
요약: 다이아몬드 값이 떨어지면 보석상은 이익 내기가 힘들어진다.
notes: if + 현재시제(drops) → 주절 will: 실제로 일어날 수 있는 조건. would struggle ✕ → will struggle ○
한 문장에 if가 둘이면 절마다 따로 판단 (앞은 상상 could, 뒤는 가능성 will).

en: Only 50 years ago, if you had said the word "algorithms," most people would have asked, "Pardon?" since [[each person]] [[had]] [[his or her own idea of what technology should look like at that time]].
key: 각 사람은 자기만의 생각을 가지고 있었다.
me: Only 50 years ago, if you had said the word "algorithms," most people would have asked, "Pardon?" since
his or her own idea of what technology should look like at that time.
easy: Each person had his or her own idea
각 사람은 자기만의 생각을 가지고 있었다(have(가지다)).
of what technology should look like
기술이 어떤 모습이어야 하는지에 대한(look like(~처럼 보이다)).
Only 50 years ago, if you had said the word "algorithms," most people would have asked, "Pardon?"
불과 50년 전에 '알고리즘'이라고 말했다면 대부분 '네?' 하고 되물었을 것이다(ask(묻다)).
요약: 그 시절 사람들은 기술이 어떤 모습일지 각자 자기 생각이 있었다.
notes: each + 단수명사는 단수 취급이라 대명사도 단수: his or her ○ / their ✕
each, every, one + 단수명사는 모두 단수로 받는다.

en: If she reveals new information about black holes, the scientific community will be surprised, since [[many scientists]] currently [[talk]] about the topic as if it were already fully understood.
me: If she reveals new information about black holes, the scientific community will be surprised, since
about the topic as if it were already fully understood.
easy: about the topic as if it were already fully understood
마치 그 주제가 이미 완전히 이해된 것처럼(understand(이해하다)) 그것에 대해.
If she reveals new information about black holes, the scientific community will be surprised
그녀가 블랙홀에 대한 새 정보를 밝히면(reveal(밝히다)) 과학계는 놀랄 것이다(surprise(놀라게 하다)).
요약: 아직 다 모르는 주제를 과학자들이 다 아는 듯 말하니 새 정보에 놀랄 것이다.
notes: as if + 과거형: 사실과 다른 상상. 가정법에서는 주어가 단수(it)여도 were. was ✕ → were ○
were understood는 '이해되다'라는 수동 형태.

en: Agatha nodded her head as if she understood the instructions, but she clearly did not, and [[the confusion]] [[happened]] again during the next task.
me: Agatha nodded her head as if she understood the instructions, but she clearly did not, and
easy: Agatha nodded her head as if she understood the instructions, but she clearly did not
Agatha는 지시를 이해한 듯 고개를 끄덕였지만(nod(끄덕이다)) 분명히 이해하지 못했다.
요약: 이해한 척했지만 못 알아들어서, 다음 과제에서 또 혼란이 생겼다.
notes: happen은 목적어가 없는 동사라 수동태로 쓸 수 없다. was happened ✕ → happened ○ (occur, appear 등도 같다)
수동태(be p.p.)는 목적어가 있는 동사만 가능하다.

en: There would be less traffic on the road if more people rode bicycles or subways, and [[the air]] [[would be]] [[cleaner]] today if the city had built more bike lanes decades ago.
me: There would be less traffic on the road if more people rode bicycles or subways, and
today if the city had built more bike lanes decades ago.
easy: if the city had built more bike lanes decades ago
시가 수십 년 전에 자전거 도로를 더 많이 지었더라면(build(짓다)).
There would be less traffic on the road if more people rode bicycles or subways
더 많은 사람이 자전거나 지하철을 탄다면(ride(타다)) 도로 교통량이 줄 것이다.
요약: 옛날에 자전거 도로를 더 지었다면 지금 공기가 더 깨끗했을 것이다.
notes: if절의 decades ago(수십 년 전)는 과거에 안 한 일 → had p.p. built ✕ → had built ○
주절 would be … today: 그 결과가 지금이라 would + 동사원형을 썼다.

en: If the invention of the printing press had not occurred, the spread of knowledge would be much slower throughout history, and never could [[we]] [[have predicted]] [[how differently society would function today]].
key: 우리는 사회가 어떻게 돌아갈지 예측하지 못했을 것이다.
me: If the invention of the printing press had not occurred, the spread of knowledge would be much slower throughout history, and never
how differently society would function today.
easy: We could never have predicted how society would function
우리는 사회가 어떻게 돌아갈지 결코 예측하지 못했을 것이다(predict(예측하다)). (원래 순서로 바꿔 본 거예요.)
how differently society would function today
If the invention of the printing press had not occurred, the spread of knowledge would be much slower throughout history
인쇄술의 발명이 없었다면(occur(일어나다)) 지식의 확산은 역사 내내 훨씬 더 느렸을 것이다.
요약: 인쇄술이 없었다면 지금 사회가 어떤 모습일지 아무도 상상 못 했을 것이다.
notes: 부정어(never, hardly, little 등)가 문장 앞 → 조동사 + 주어 순서. never we could have predicted ✕ → never could we have predicted ○
could have p.p. = ~할 수 있었을 것이다.

en: If you never drive a car yourself, you will never learn driving because it requires experience to improve, though if you take lessons from a professional instructor, [[you]] [[will improve]] much faster.
key: 당신은 훨씬 더 빨리 나아질 것이다.
me: If you never drive a car yourself, you will never learn driving because it requires experience to improve, though if you take lessons from a professional instructor,
easy: if you take lessons from a professional instructor
If you never drive a car yourself, you will never learn driving
직접 운전하지 않으면 운전을 결코 못 배운다(learn(배우다)).
요약: 직접 운전해야 늘지만, 전문 강사에게 배우면 훨씬 빨리 는다.
notes: if + 현재시제(take) → 주절 will: 실제로 일어날 수 있는 조건. would improve ✕ → will improve ○
much faster: 비교급 앞의 much는 '훨씬' (강조).

en: I would have cooked at home more often if the kitchen in my apartment were bigger, and [[I]] usually just [[ordered]] [[takeout]] instead since there was a lack of space.
me: I would have cooked at home more often if the kitchen in my apartment were bigger, and
instead since there was a lack of space.
easy: since there was a lack of space
I would have cooked at home more often if the kitchen in my apartment were bigger
아파트 부엌이 더 컸다면 집에서 더 자주 요리했을 텐데(cook(요리하다)).
요약: 부엌이 좁아서 요리 대신 포장 음식을 시켜 먹었다.
notes: since(~ 때문에) + 주어+동사: 이 뜻의 since는 접속사라 뒤에 절이 온다. since a lack of space ✕ → since there was a lack of space ○
There was a lack of space = 공간 부족이 있었다 (There is/was ~ = ~이 있다).
